title: Logins blocked the whole API
shouldHaveCaught: An API test that sends a request while a login is still being hashed. The 34 API tests sent one request at a time, so nothing ever waited behind a login.

title: Duplicate webhook processed twice (receiver)
shouldHaveCaught: Caught by the receiver's own concurrency test before the first push.

title: Duplicate webhook: the sender gave up on a 409 and lost the event
shouldHaveCaught: An end-to-end test of sender and receiver where the first attempt is still running when the retry arrives.

title: Windows line endings rejected every SQL check
shouldHaveCaught: A run on Windows, or a test fixture saved with CRLF line endings. CI ran on Linux only.

title: A mistyped tag passed green
shouldHaveCaught: Caught while adding smoke runs to pull requests; it never reached main.

title: Live tokens in published reports
shouldHaveCaught: A secret scan of every report before it was kept as a CI artifact. The reports were never opened, because nobody reads a passing report closely.

title: Game day: the line to the database was cut
shouldHaveCaught: A timestamped, readable error log and a page rule tested under an outage. The drill found the log unreadable and the page slow to clear.
